To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) exercise format and engagement are key factors in students’ exercise performance, and (2) feature engineering is an important step in modeling students’ learning traces in Second Language Acquisition.

(i) exercise format and exercise engagement are two important factors that impact students’ exercise performance, (ii) exercise format and engagement can be captured through a variety of features, (iii) a Gradient Tree Boosted model can achieve good performance on the task of predicting students’ exercise performance.

1) students who have more experience with a given exercise format are better able to solve exercises in that format; 2) students’ engagement is a strong indicator for exercise performance; and 3) the number of exercises that a student solves in a day is negatively correlated with their exercise performance.
